Package edu.cnu.mdi.view

Class AbstractViewInfo

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.view.AbstractViewInfo
Direct Known Subclasses:
DrawingViewInfo, ImageEvolutionViewInfo, JsonViewInfo, MapViewInfo, NetworkDeclutterViewInfo, PlotViewInfo, TspDemoViewInfo
public abstract class AbstractViewInfo extends Object
Base class for View Information. Extend this for each View type to provide standardized documentation. Design goals:
  • Centralize look and feel (typography, spacing, section layout)
  • Prefer structured data over ad-hoc HTML snippets
  • Still allow optional raw HTML fragments when needed

    • getUsageHtml

      public String getUsageHtml()
      If you really need custom HTML for usage, you may return a raw HTML fragment here (e.g., a table, links, etc.). If non-blank, it is inserted as-is. Prefer getUsageBullets() / getUsageSteps() when possible.
      Returns:
      Raw HTML fragment for usage instructions, or null/blank to use structured bullets/steps.
